subtopic: Best Interest Obligations and Conflicts of Interest
source_evidence: Brokers are required to act in your best interest when making a recommendation and not put their interest ahead of yours.
answer: When a broker makes an investment recommendation, the broker must act in your best interest and must not put the broker’s own interests ahead of yours. However, the way brokers earn money can create conflicts with your interests. Ask about those conflicts and consider how the broker is paid, what services and products are offered, and any limits on those offerings. These details can affect the services and recommendations you receive.
